_comment: Copy to sources.json to aggregate more than the local ~/.claude. All keys are optional; CLI flags on jsonl_ingest.py override these. This file is also how the live receiver learns about extra sources.
_timing_comment: How hard a bad host is allowed to make anyone wait. ssh_connect_timeout bounds reaching a machine that is off; ssh_timeout bounds one whole transfer; remote_budget caps the time all hosts together may take in a single background pass.
